method: Manual review of frames sampled with tracks.common.media.sample_frames at 0.2 fps (0-335 s), 0.5 fps (0-212 s) and 0.5 fps contact sheets around boundaries. Times are the first/last sampled frame where the paper clearly shows the state (resolution about 1-2 s). Hands-in-motion frames between states are transitions.
window_rationale: t=0 flat square sheet; bird base complete and shown at t~190-194; from t~196 the expert narrows the flaps (crane steps beyond the bird base).

states.name: book-folded rectangle
properties: square folded in half edge to edge
states.notes: Folded in half one way (8-16), unfolded/flipped (18-22), folded the other way (24-28); square with cross creases visible 30-34 (counted as transition).

states.name: diagonal-folded triangle
states.notes: Both diagonals folded; 46-48 flip between the two diagonal folds.

states.name: square base
properties: collapsed into a smaller square (diamond orientation)
states.notes: Unfolded star crease pattern 62-66 and collapse 68-70 are transitions (preliminary base).

states.name: kite form
properties: lower edges folded to the centre crease
top triangle folded down over the kite folds
states.notes: Kite folds 82-98, top triangle folded down 100-106; these are creasing folds, unfolded 114-122 before the petal fold.

states.name: petal fold one side
properties: front layer lifted and folded upward
long diamond with a tall flap on one side
back side still a square base
states.notes: Unfold 114-122, petal fold 124-148. 158-188 the model is flipped, the kite folds and petal fold are repeated on the back (transition).

states.name: bird base
properties: two flaps at the bottom that can separate
states.notes: Shown flat at 190 and lifted with flaps visible at 192.

key_state.rule: state with the longest expert transition into it (start_j - end_{j-1}, using each state's first start and last end); transitions: R1 5 s, R2 10 s, R3 14 s, R4 8 s, R5 38 s, R6 33 s
key_state.note: Matches the usual origami view that the petal fold is the critical step of the bird base.
